Mass Communication Studies

minor
  • Home
  • Undergraduate Catalog
  • Colleges and Schools
  • Journalism and Communications | College of
  • Mass Communication Studies Minor

The Mass Communication Studies minor provides students with an excellent overview of the role media plays in modern society. The topics discussed in Mass Communication courses directly relate to positions in marketing, sales, public relations, and administration in public and government agencies.

About this Program

  • College: Journalism and Communications
  • Credits: 15 | Completed with minimum grades of C and no S/U
  • Contact: 1060 Weimer Hall

Department Information

Graduates of the Department of Journalism work in traditional forms of media, emerging platforms, and in corporate roles. Ultimately, the department offers transferrable skills that creates outstanding leaders with successful achievements across all fields.

This minor is not open to College of Journalism and Communications majors.

Applicants must receive approval of their college’s dean before obtaining Journalism and Communications college approval in 1060 Weimer Hall.
Map

Nine of the required 15 credits must be completed at UF.
